newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves new Enron investment.
newsitem.headline: India approves new Enron investment.

text.p: India's Industry Ministry on Thursday said it had approved investments totalling 3.5 billion rupees ($97.77 million) for "the development of new projects in the field of power generation".
Enron is building a $2.3 billion power plant in the western Indian state of Maharashtra. The Industry Ministry statement did not specify where the new projects were to be located.

The announcement came close on the heels of a statement by Power Minister Y.K. Alagh that the government will announce a new power policy after the monsoon session of Parliament, which is scheduled to start in the third week of July.
The policy will encompass all aspects of the power sector, including generation, transmission and distribution.
